description: Use when an agent needs the gist of a web page or PDF. Returns a short or medium summary with key points, and says whether the document was cut at 20,000 tokens and how much was read. Uses only what the document says. Costs 0.02 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

url.description: the page or PDF: an absolute http or https URL

name: get_summarize

data.description: the get_summarize payload; a real captured example is free at https://x402.ochinimus.app/api/sample/get_summarize

tool.description: the tool that produced this payload

title: Page or PDF summary
